UnitStatement: frontend package "chirality-frontend" v0.1.0 is a private workspace described as the frontend bootstrap for the Chirality desktop runtime.
Electron main entry point is dist-electron/main.js.
dev script runs Next and Electron concurrently via "npm run dev:next" and "npm run dev:electron".
dev:next launches "next dev --port 3000" with NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1.
dev:electron builds the Electron bundle, waits on tcp:3000, then launches electron dist-electron/main.js.
build script runs "next build" (telemetry disabled) followed by build:electron.
build:electron compiles Electron sources via "tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json".
test script runs "vitest run".
typecheck runs tsc --noEmit for both the app and tsconfig.electron.json configs with incremental disabled.
harness:validate:section8 runs node ./scripts/validate-harness-section8.mjs.
harness:validate:premerge runs node ./scripts/validate-harness-premerge.mjs.
instruction-root:integrity runs node ./scripts/verify-instruction-root-integrity.mjs.
proof:network-policy runs node ./scripts/run-network-policy-proof.mjs.
desktop:pack builds, runs electron-builder --mac --arm64 --dir with auto-discovery off and no publish, then runs instruction-root:integrity.
desktop:dist builds, runs electron-builder --mac dmg --arm64 with no publish, then runs instruction-root:integrity.
Runtime depends on @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk pinned at 0.3.150 and @anthropic-ai/sdk pinned at 0.93.0.
Frontend uses Next ^14.2.0, React/React-DOM ^18.2.0, react-markdown ^10.1.0, and remark-gfm ^4.0.1.
Dev dependencies include electron ^31.0.2, electron-builder ^25.1.8, typescript ^5.6.3, and vitest ^2.1.8.
Node engine requirement is >=20.
electron-builder appId is com.chirality.app and productName is Chirality, packaged with asar enabled.
Packaged build files include dist-electron, .next, node_modules, package.json, and next.config.mjs.
extraResources bundle the agents directory (../../../agents), the docs directory (../docs), and root files AGENTS.md, README.md, PROFESSIONAL_ENGINEERING.md from the monorepo root.
macOS build targets arm64 dmg, minimumSystemVersion 15.0.0, category public.app-category.developer-tools.
LOOPBACK_HOSTS set treats localhost, 127.0.0.1, ::1, and [::1] as loopback endpoints.
ALLOWLIST_HOSTS set contains only api.anthropic.com as an allowlisted outbound host.
Defaults: 3 proof runs, 600s idle window, 60s idle sample interval, 120000ms HTTP timeout, 4000ms startup wait.
timestampForPath formats an ISO date into a path-safe token by stripping colons and fractional seconds and replacing T with underscore.
parseIntegerArg returns the fallback unless the value parses to a safe positive integer.
parseArgs accepts --runs, --idle-seconds, --idle-sample-seconds, and --output-dir flags; output defaults under DEL-03-06 Evidence with an OI-002_PROOF timestamp.
parseRemoteHost extracts the host from an lsof remote endpoint, handling bracketed IPv6 and trailing-port colon forms.
classifyRemoteHost classifies a host as loopback, allowlisted, anthropic_non_allowlisted (*.anthropic.com), external_non_allowlisted, or unknown.
parseLsofTcp parses lsof output lines containing "->" into remote endpoint records with endpoint, host, and class.
runCommand spawns a child process capturing stdout/stderr and resolves with {code,stdout,stderr}, defaulting code to 1.
startLoggedProcess spawns a labeled child process appending stdout/stderr and START/EXIT markers to a log file.
stopProcess sends SIGTERM, waits up to timeoutMs, escalates to SIGKILL, and throws if the process fails to stop.
waitForHttpReady polls a URL until ok or 404, throwing if the watched process exits early or the timeout elapses.
postJson POSTs a JSON payload and returns {status,ok,raw,parsed} with best-effort JSON parse.
postTurnSse POSTs a payload and parses the SSE response into events with event name, raw data, and parsed JSON.
captureTcpSnapshot runs lsof for a pid filtered to TCP LISTEN/ESTABLISHED/SYN_SENT/CLOSE_WAIT states and appends the snapshot to tcp_snapshots.ndjson.
summarizeSnapshotEndpoints deduplicates remote endpoints across snapshots keyed by host|endpoint|class.
extractProbePayloads parses JSON payloads following the [network-policy-probe] marker in log text.
runProofCycle copies examples/example-project into a /tmp working root and sets up an isolated session root per run.
Proof cycle base env sets ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (defaulting to a placeholder), CHIRALITY_ANTHROPIC_STREAM_TIMEOUT_MS, and CHIRALITY_SESSION_ROOT.
Proof cycle starts Next dev bound to 127.0.0.1:3000 then launches Electron against ELECTRON_RENDERER_URL http://127.0.0.1:3000.
Network policy probe URLs are an external blocked-check URL, https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages, and the local Next origin.
Electron probe is configured via CHIRALITY_NETWORK_POLICY_PROBE_URLS, _PROBE_DELAY_MS (2500), and _PROBE_TIMEOUT_MS (8000).
Proof cycle exercises session create, boot, and a turn SSE against /api/harness endpoints, capturing TCP snapshots at startup, post-boot, post-turn, and idle intervals.
Blocked renderer diagnostics are counted by matching "Blocked renderer outbound request by network policy" in the Electron log.
Per-run verdict requires no non-allowlisted outbound TCP, observed blocked-renderer diagnostics, observed probe payloads, and a completed scenario with process:exit events.
CONF-002 (OCSP/CRL infrastructure carve-out) remains unresolved; the TCP summary flags only explicit non-allowlisted external endpoints.
runProofCycle finally-block stops electron and next processes and removes the temporary working and session roots.
aggregateRunVerdicts marks the proof passed only when zero runs fail all four verdict conditions.
renderMarkdownSummary produces an OI-002 Option B proof summary with aggregate verdict and a per-run results table.
main parses args, builds the Electron bundle (failing if non-zero exit), runs each proof cycle independently, and writes summary.json and SUMMARY.md.
Each proof run restarts runtime processes per cycle to keep runs independent per the proof standard.
Process exit code is set to 1 when the aggregate proof verdict is not passed.
REQUIRED_TEST_IDS enumerates eight required harness checks including setup.server_reachable, regression.session_crud, and six section8.* checks.
LEGACY_REMOVED_TEST_ID regression.api_chat_reachability must not appear in the summary.
parseMachineLine extracts a "key=" machine-readable value from stdout, throwing if absent.
runSection8Script spawns the section8 validation script, mirroring stdout/stderr and resolving with {code,stdout,stderr}.
Premerge main resolves scripts/validate-harness-section8.mjs and a stable artifact path artifacts/harness/section8/latest/summary.json.
If the section8 script is unreadable, premerge emits RUNTIME_SURFACE_MISSING and fail status with exit code 1.
Premerge throws unless HARNESS_VALIDATION_STATUS parsed from section8 stdout equals "pass".
Premerge throws if any REQUIRED_TEST_IDS entry is missing from the summary results.
Premerge throws if the summary includes the legacy removed test id.
Premerge copies the source summary to the stable artifact path and verifies readability.
HARNESS_PREMERGE_STATUS is pass only when every result row has status pass; exit code follows the status.
HARNESS_BASE_URL defaults to http://127.0.0.1:3000.
Output is written under TMPDIR/chirality-harness-validation/latest with api, sse, logs, and cleanup subdirectories.
REQUIRED_CHECK_ORDER fixes the ordered sequence of eight harness validation checks.
resolveProjectRoot honors HARNESS_PROJECT_ROOT, else searches for examples/example-project, falling back to a TMP_ROOT default.
resolveInstructionRoot picks the first candidate containing an agents directory, honoring CHIRALITY_INSTRUCTION_ROOT.
isPathWithin returns true when targetPath is equal to or nested under basePath (no .. or absolute relative).
prepareProjectRoot stages a copy of the requested project root when it lies within the instruction root, otherwise uses it directly.
parseSse splits raw SSE text on blank lines and parses event/data lines into {type,data} events with best-effort JSON.
assertOrderedEvents verifies the listed event types appear in the given order within the events array.
requestSseWithInterrupt streams a turn and concurrently POSTs /api/harness/interrupt, retrying for up to 2000ms while it returns 404.
Check setup.server_reachable asserts GET /api/harness/session/list returns 200.
Check regression.session_crud verifies create, list (includes session), get 200, delete, and get-after-delete 404.
Check section8.boot_error_taxonomy asserts boot returns SESSION_NOT_FOUND(404), PERSONA_NOT_FOUND(404), SDK_FAILURE(500), and WORKING_ROOT_INACCESSIBLE(404).
Boot with model "__BOOT_SDK_FAIL__" returns HTTP 500 with error type SDK_FAILURE.
Check section8.smoke_stream asserts turn SSE emits ordered session:init, chat:delta, chat:complete, session:complete, process:exit.
Check section8.session_persistence_resume asserts claudeSessionId is persisted and unchanged across two turns (resume continuity).
Check section8.permissions_dontask: in dontAsk mode an UNAPPROVED_DENY tool result reports ok=false and an UNAPPROVED_ALLOW tool result reports ok=true with the marker output.
Check section8.interrupt_sigint asserts the interrupt endpoint returns 200 ok and the stream emits process:exit with interrupted=true and exitCode 130.
Check section8.sdk_native_stream asserts the turn emits chat:complete and process:exit and never emits parse:error.
Missing required checks are normalized to fail rows with error "Check did not execute".
Overall status is pass only when every normalized result is pass; summary.json records status and per-result rows.
Section8 emits HARNESS_VALIDATION_SUMMARY_PATH and HARNESS_VALIDATION_STATUS, with exit code 0 on pass.
REQUIRED_ROOT_FILES are AGENTS.md, README.md, and PROFESSIONAL_ENGINEERING.md.
REQUIRED_DOC_FILES are DIRECTIVE.md, CONTRACT.md, SPEC.md, TYPES.md, PLAN.md, and WHAT-IS-AN-AGENT.md.
printUsage documents options --source-root, --root-files-root, --agents-root, --docs-root, --bundle-root, --output-root, and --help.
sha256ForFile returns the sha256 digest and size of a file, throwing for non-file entries.
readGitSha returns "git rev-parse HEAD" output for the source root or null on failure.
hasMonolithicInstructionRootShape checks for agents/, AGENTS.md, and docs/DIRECTIVE.md in a candidate root.
hasSplitInstructionRootShape checks all required root files, the agents root, and all required doc files exist.
resolveDefaultSourceRoots prefers a monolithic CHIRALITY_INSTRUCTION_ROOT, else a split layout (monorepo root + app-dev docs), else a monolithic fallback.
listSourceAgentFiles returns sorted AGENT_*.md files in the agents root, throwing if none are found.
listBundleAgentFiles returns sorted posix agents/AGENT_*.md paths from the bundle, or empty if the directory is unreadable.
buildSourceManifest computes sha256/size entries for required root files, doc files, and agent files with bundle-relative paths.
verifyManifestAgainstBundle compares source vs bundle sha256, collecting missingInBundle, mismatchedFiles, and unexpectedBundleAgentFiles.
Integrity status is pass only when there are no missing, mismatched, or unexpected bundle agent files.
main writes manifest.json and summary.json to the output root and exits non-zero (with diagnostics) when status is not pass.
SessionRecord type includes sessionId, projectRoot, persona, mode, createdAt, updatedAt, and optional claudeSessionId, bootFingerprint, bootedAt, and model.
importRouteModules resets modules, imports the harness create/list/[id]/boot/turn/interrupt routes and runtime, and calls resetHarnessRuntimeForTests.
Test setup builds a tmp project root and instruction root (agents, docs, AGENTS.md, README.md, required doc files) and sets CHIRALITY_SESSION_ROOT and CHIRALITY_INSTRUCTION_ROOT.
Test: session create/list/get/delete happy path; delete returns {ok:true} and a subsequent get returns 404 with SESSION_NOT_FOUND.
Test: create with missing projectRoot returns 400 INVALID_REQUEST.
Test: create with an inaccessible projectRoot returns 404 WORKING_ROOT_INACCESSIBLE.
Test: a projectRoot overlapping the instruction root returns 409 WORKING_ROOT_CONFLICT.
Test: boot persists boot metadata (claudeSessionId, bootFingerprint, bootedAt) and the session bootFingerprint matches the boot result.
Test: subagentGovernance passes through boot opts to startTurn (called with "bootstrap") without being consumed in fallback resolution.
Test: booting an uncreated session returns 404 SESSION_NOT_FOUND.
Test: booting a session whose projectRoot was removed returns 404 WORKING_ROOT_INACCESSIBLE.
Test: boot referencing an unknown persona returns 404 PERSONA_NOT_FOUND.
Test: missing required instruction files (e.g. docs/PLAN.md) returns 500 INSTRUCTION_ROOT_INVALID.
Test: INSTRUCTION_ROOT_INVALID taxonomy is preserved across module-bundle boundaries and the runtime singleton is shared.
Test: bootstrap turn exiting non-zero (model __BOOT_SDK_FAIL__) returns 500 SDK_FAILURE.
Test: a turn for a missing session returns pre-stream 404 SESSION_NOT_FOUND (JSON) and startTurn is not called.
Test: a turn streams ordered SSE events session:init, chat:delta, chat:complete, session:complete, process:exit with content-type text/event-stream.
Test: invalid governance metadata keeps the parent turn running and startTurn receives delegatedSubagents: [].
Test: opts.subagentGovernance cannot bypass the runtime environment gate; delegatedSubagents stays empty when the env flag is unset.
Test: when CHIRALITY_ENABLE_SUBAGENTS=true and governance gates are satisfied, startTurn receives delegatedSubagents: ["TASK"].
Test: a failing runtime turn emits turn:error then process:exit with phase mid-stream, fatal true, exitCode 1, and errorType SDK_FAILURE.
Test: selecting the anthropic provider without an API key returns pre-stream 503 MISSING_API_KEY and startTurn is not called.
Test: an attachment-only turn where all attachments fail and no text remains returns 400 ATTACHMENT_FAILURE (ALL_ATTACHMENTS_FAILED_NO_TEXT).
Test: partial attachment failure prepends an attachment warning text block listing rejected attachments before the user message and includes the valid file block.
Test: with no executable attachments, the turn uses string-prompt mode and passes no content-block array to startTurn.
Test: when all attachments fail but text remains, the turn falls back to string-prompt mode embedding an attachment warning in the message.
Test: when rejected attachment detail entries exceed the cap, the warning includes an "... N additional attachment error(s) omitted" summary.
Test: overlapping turns for the same session return 409 TURN_IN_PROGRESS, and the lock is released after completion allowing a recovery turn.
Test: the interrupt endpoint returns 200 {ok:true} and the active turn stream emits process:exit with "interrupted":true.
Test: turn and interrupt routes remain coherent across module-bundle boundaries sharing the runtime singleton.
Test: interrupt on an unknown session returns 404 SESSION_NOT_FOUND.
Scaffold test decomposition fixture defines package PKG-05 "Filesystem Execution Model" with deliverable DEL-05-02 of type BACKEND_FEATURE_SLICE.
Test: POST /api/harness/scaffold returns 200 with packageCount 1, deliverableCount 1, coordinationMode SCHEDULE_FIRST, valid layout, and ready preparation compatibility.
Scaffold creates _Coordination/_COORDINATION.md and the PKG-05/1_Working/DEL-05-02 deliverable directory.
Scaffold _COORDINATION.md records "**Representation:** SCHEDULE_FIRST".
Test: scaffold with missing required fields returns 400 INVALID_REQUEST.
Test: scaffold blocked by a filesystem conflict returns 409 WORKING_ROOT_INACCESSIBLE with FAIL_FAST strategy, stage ensure_tool_root, and the conflicting target path.
statusDocument helper builds a _STATUS.md body with Current State, Last Updated, and a History entry.
createDeliverable helper writes a deliverable under <pkg>/1_Working/<deliverable> with a _STATUS.md and listed files.
Test: GET /api/project/deliverables returns deliverables, knowledge marker metadata, and knowledge type mappings.
Deliverable status from _STATUS.md is lowercased (e.g. IN_PROGRESS -> in_progress) in the route response.
knowledgeDecomposition reports enabled with the Domain_Handbook.md marker file when present in _Decomposition.
knowledgeTypes maps Datasheet.md, Specification.md, and MEMORY.md files to datasheet, specification, and memory knowledge types keyed by PKG::DEL.
Test: with no domain marker file, knowledgeDecomposition reports enabled false and markerFile null.
Test: a missing project root returns 404 WORKING_ROOT_INACCESSIBLE.
Initial fixture _STATUS.md sets Current State INITIALIZED with a History of OPEN then INITIALIZED transitions.
makeDependencyRow builds a v3.1 DependencyRegisterRow defaulting DEP-05-03-001 from PKG-05/DEL-05-03 to PKG-05/DEL-05-02 with EXECUTION/PREREQUISITE classification.
importRouteModules imports the working-root deliverable status, status/transition, and dependencies routes.
Test: GET status reads parsed lifecycle currentState INITIALIZED from _STATUS.md.
Test: an authorized WORKING_ITEMS transition to IN_PROGRESS persists the new state and a dated History entry in _STATUS.md.
Test: a WORKING_ITEMS transition to CHECKING returns 400 UNAUTHORIZED_ACTOR.
Test: HUMAN transitions to CHECKING and ISSUED return 400 APPROVAL_SHA_REQUIRED when approvalSha is absent.
A HUMAN CHECKING transition with a valid approvalSha (e.g. abc1234) returns 200.
Test: a malformed approvalSha (e.g. "not-a-sha") on a human-gated transition returns 400 INVALID_APPROVAL_SHA.
Test: GET dependencies reads Dependencies.csv rows including DEP-05-03-001 and headers containing RegisterSchemaVersion.
Test: a deliverablePath symlink resolving outside projectRoot returns 400 DELIVERABLE_PATH_OUTSIDE_PROJECT_ROOT.
Test: a dependency PUT whose FromDeliverableID mismatches the host deliverable returns 400 INVALID_IDENTITY.
Test: a dependency PUT with an invalid SatisfactionStatus jump (e.g. straight to SATISFIED) returns 400 INVALID_SATISFACTION_TRANSITION.
Test: a valid dependency PUT (SatisfactionStatus IN_PROGRESS) returns 200 and persists IN_PROGRESS to Dependencies.csv.
